comment: With subwindows off, Help, Connect an Agent put its notice along the bottom of the main window and the Reference and Layers dockers, windows of the operating system, stood over both its ends. The six dockers the default layout opens are placed where it puts them, subwindows are switched off, the row is pressed, and the state names the notice's rectangle beside the rectangle of every window of its own the probe finds. No docker's rectangle may touch the notice's. Needs a compositor that lets an X client place its windows: `mutter --headless --wayland --virtual-monitor 1920x1080 -- godot --path sara-godot --display-driver x11 -- --capture=... --settings-dir=...`. Under sara_shot.py's nested weston a toplevel has no position and under weston's Xwayland the window manager moves it, so the probe would not read the dockers where the steps put them (pitfalls/capture2.md). A second press follows with Layers moved down to the bottom right corner, so both ends of the bottom strip are covered, the way the window had them. The row is Modules, Local Server, a tick: the first press opens the server and its dialog and puts up no notice, and the second closes the server and puts one up.
